description: Main FastAPI application setup and route definitions for the Poll Engagement Analytics Platform backend, including endpoints for health check, event logging, analytics querying, and poll summary metrics.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Endpoint to verify the operational status of the analytics service.

methods.name: log_poll_event(payload: PollEventIn = Body(..., description="Event object with pollId, eventId, device metadata, etc."))
methods.description: Endpoint to log poll events such as impressions or votes with deduplication.

methods.name: analytics_query( filter: EventFilter = Body(..., description="Filter parameters for pollId, event_type, user_id, date range, etc."), limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=500), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0) )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve filtered poll event logs for analytics purposes.

methods.name: poll_summary( poll_id: str = Query(..., description="Poll id to fetch analytics for") )
methods.description: Endpoint to get high-level summary metrics for a specific poll.
